sources.entry: Crypto Bar - macOS menu bar application built with Electron.

summary.one_liner: Crypto Bar is a macOS menu bar app built with Electron and React that shows cryptocurrency prices updated in real time over WebSockets, with data from CryptoCompare.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs in the macOS menu bar and displays cryptocurrency prices. It uses WebSockets to update prices in real time. The README says the data comes from CryptoCompare, which covers most cryptocurrencies and exchanges. The app is built with Electron and React. The README includes steps to clone the repo and run it locally in development mode. The author says the project is no longer maintained.
use_cases: track crypto prices from the macOS menu bar
monitor coin prices without opening a browser
view CryptoCompare market data on the desktop
run an Electron React menu bar app as a reference
caveats: The author says the project is no longer maintained and is looking for a new maintainer.
The README lists only macOS as the target platform for the menu bar app.
Installation from source requires npm and a local development setup.
